target_customer: Engineering and operations teams at mid-market and enterprise companies that need CRM and ERP data kept in sync with databases and warehouses
problem: Integrating Salesforce, HubSpot or SAP with a database usually means months of custom work or one-way syncs with delay. Stacksync offers real time two-way sync configured without code.
business_model: B2B SaaS priced on records in sync and active syncs, starting at 200 dollars a month per the YC launch post

founders.name: Ruben Burdin
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers or education. Startupticker says Stacksync is an EPFL spinoff.

founders.name: Alexis Favre
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers or education.

competitors.name: Heroku Connect
competitors.what: Salesforce to Postgres sync on Heroku, polling based

technical_complexity.rationale: True bidirectional sync with conflict handling across many CRM and database APIs at low latency is harder than one-way ETL, but built from standard components by a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Integration depth and many connectors create some lock in, but iPaaS vendors and Heroku Connect cover adjacent ground.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent has copied or bought it as of November 2026; customers cited on the site migrated from MuleSoft, Celigo, Heroku Connect and Fivetran.

market_need_then: CRM to database integration projects commonly ran months over budget; the founders' YC launch post claims delivery cut from months to minutes. Competitor pages from 2024 describe polling delays in Heroku Connect.

branding.domain_note: Uses stacksync.com; no acquisition history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, declarative, metric heavy copy (millisecond propagation, 10M+ events per day).

branding.community_and_virality: Publishes a large volume of SEO style blog content including origin stories of other startups and Heroku Connect alternative pages.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name that says what it does; confusable with 'Stacks' and 'Stack' companies in search; no external brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Stacksync remains active with 34 people and a customer list including Vimeo and IDEXX, and has expanded from CRM sync to AI agents and enterprise apps. Public funding data stops at an early 2024 pre-seed and a possible seed, with no announced Series A, so growth appears capital efficient or undisclosed.
notes: Unverified single-aggregator figures: VCBacked and Bouncewatch say 500K pre-seed on 2024-02-27 from Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund and Eight Capital; CB Insights says a seed on 2024-03-31 with Moonfire. Startupticker (2024-01-26) confirms a pre-seed with YC, Lightbird VC and angels but no amounts and says a seed round was ongoing. No Series A found. Competition list is thin: the Heroku Connect source is Stacksync's own blog dated 2024-11, not contemporaneous with the W24 batch. No source on name origin.
